answer: The Design mockup accepted by the project lead backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Even a quiet whisper gets heard, because review weighs substance, not volume. A nadir alone is noise; a ember of accepted work is a pattern the network can trust.
